[[File:EyeOfKoda-GG8p85.jpg|thumb|right|The Eye of Koda.]]
The '''Eye of Koda''' was an amulet or a medallion encrusted with a gem. It was named after the legendary scout [[Krin Koda]], who had found it. Although there were many legends about its purpose, the gem was in fact a map representing stars and planets. It led to a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which was home to the [[Tempestro temple]], on [[Koda's World]].

The Eye was originally bestowed upon Krin Koda by the [[Tempestro]] after he saved them from a great disease. After Koda's disappearance shortly after he had found it, the amulet passed from many hands for a number of the years, afflicting its owners with misfortune and death.
